answer.rationale: Deploy value-realization messaging to price-sensitive SMB accounts showing churn signals, emphasizing first meaningful outcomes and existing product value rather than matching the competitor’s price cut. Activation messaging has evidence of improving week-one engagement and meaningful-action completion, while shorter paths to value have supported early adoption and retention. Do not use broad promotional pricing: the recovered discount experiment increased acquisition and qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, creating a material sustainable-revenue risk. Evidence does not directly establish that activation messaging prevents price-driven churn in established accounts, so contain the intervention and monitor retention, expansion, and qualified revenue quality.
